headline: Walmart lets Meta's AI shopping agent Muse handle Black Friday purchases
summary: Walmart has enabled Meta's AI agent Muse to shop and purchase Black Friday deals on its site, extending the retailer's Agent Gateway integration announced last month.

claims.statement: Walmart now allows Meta's Muse AI agent to shop Black Friday deals on its website.

sources.quote: Meta Muse can now do your Black Friday shopping at Walmart
Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse

claims.statement: The rollout builds on Walmart's Agent Gateway, announced last month, which lets AI agents find products without sharing a shopper's purchase history.

sources.quote: The retail giant is rolling out a live implementation of the Agent Gateway it announced last month
